verdict.rationale: Collaborating with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels is a fair question for a team chat product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions guest accounts, external or shared channels, or restricting outside users' access. The closest items, a canvas comment-only role and multi-workspace developer sandboxes, are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can collaborate with external partners through guest accounts or shared channels with limited access
